Our Richmond Fir is a traditional Christmas tree for any living room, grand hallway or shop display. The tree features a 3 part system offering much easier assembly, simply connect the base to the three pieces, unfold the branches, reposition and plug it in. Key features 9 lighting modes with remote control — warm white, multicolour, or combined effects in steady, fade, flash, and alternating patterns Dual-colour LED lights, pre-lit with no extra wiring needed to connect sections Full, lifelike hinged branches for quick assembly and a traditional Christmas look Sturdy stand for lasting, stable everyday use What's included 1 x pre-lit Richmond Fir Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x Storage Bag 1 x Remote control Dimensions 6ft: approx. 180cm height, approx. 100cm at base, 798 branch tips 7ft: approx. 210cm height, approx. 125cm at base, 1,098 branch tips Good to know Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty FAQs Does it need assembly? Simple assembly required — the tree sections connect together (with built-in power sockets linking the lights automatically) and attach to the stand with 3 hand-tightened bolts, no power tools needed. Once assembled, gently spread out the branches and tips to shape your tree. What lighting modes does it have? The tree features 9 modes via the included remote: steady, fading, and flashing effects in warm white, multicolour, or both combined — plus an alternating mode. How are the lights powered? The tree itself is mains-powered — simply plug in to enjoy. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (not included). Is it suitable for outdoor use? Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. ## Information
The artificial Christmas tree Cupid from tectake is the perfect choice for any home looking to enhance their festive spirit. With the trees rich green colour, it brings a cosy atmosphere to your living room. Thanks to the use of injection moulding and PVC needles, the artificial Christmas tree looks particularly realistic. In the injection moulding process, the needles are made three-dimensionally and precisely mimic real fir needles. The tree trunk with its wooden appearance enhances the realistic look and gives your Christmas tree an authentic look, making every room shine in festive splendour. A real advantage of an artificial Christmas tree is its ease of care. You don't have to worry about drying out or annoying needle loss, as is the case with real trees. It remains in perfect shape throughout the Christmas season and can be reused every year. This makes it a particularly sustainable solution for the holidays. With the innovative plug-in mechanism, the artificial pine tree can be effortlessly set up in just a few minutes. This leaves more time to add your favourite lights and best decorations so you can truly get into the Christmas spirit. The stable tree stand provides secure support and after the festive season, the Christmas tree can be dismantled into its individual parts and stored compactly. Opt for the artificial Christmas tree Cupid from tectake and enjoy a worry-free festive season in your home, without having to forgo the charm of a natural tree!
